Container.Name: ip-scout
Container.Overview: ip-scout shows which IPs are in use on your LAN/subnet -- Docker containers (read via the Docker SDK against /var/run/docker.sock) plus anything else alive on the wire (nmap, falling back to a ping sweep) -- and reports the next free IP available. Runs as a small background server with a built-in dashboard, plus a GET /api/status JSON endpoint for an external dashboard widget (e.g. Homarr's Custom API widget) -- either way, no need for SSH access every time. Needs NET_ADMIN (added below) for the raw sockets nmap/ping require -- see the README's "Network access" section for the tradeoffs.

Config.Name: Web Port
Config.Description: Port for the dashboard and the GET /api/status endpoint

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Read-only access so ip-scout can list running containers and their IPs

Config.Name: SUBNET_PREFIX
Config.Description: First three octets of the LAN to scan, e.g. 192.168.1

Config.Name: SCAN_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between background scans in serve mode
